description: Repairs r-ado-1b/fields-meta-expressions: CDec(L) is refused ("Wrong number of arguments"), so the metadata of Decimal-valued expressions (x1, x2) is missing; CDec cannot be repaired, so Decimal-valued expressions over the DECIMAL(18,4) column N are asked instead. On a read-only ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5), each SELECT alone, as a server forward-only and as a client static read-only recordset: N, N + 1, N * 1.5, N / 2, -N, N + N from K WHERE ID = 1, and Sum(N), Avg(N), Min(N) with Max(N), Count(N) from K; State and, for every field, Name, Type, DefinedSize, Precision, NumericScale and Attributes, the first row's Value and ActualSize, Connection.Errors read and cleared right after each open. Asks the type, precision, scale and value ADO publishes for Decimal expressions and aggregates.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
